asset.name: ThemeGenerator
asset.description: Produces complete semantic theme mappings from brand inputs while validating contrast, state differentiation, chart palettes, typography, and light-and-dark coherence.

requires.reason: Output is a theme over the shared semantic token layer.

rationale: Validation is the point rather than generation: a theme generator that emits an inaccessible palette has produced a liability, so contrast and state-differentiation checks run before the theme is written.
